metadata.description: Vlad's Claude Code skills and plugins

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Start features (branch, worktree, draft PR); ship them with a sized Sol review, issue-tracked problems and a merge gate.

plugins.name: sync
plugins.description: Keeps this marketplace and its installed plugins updated from GitHub at every session start, and refuses edits to their installed copies, pointing to the repo.

plugins.name: pr-comments
plugins.description: Attribution, tone and safety checks for comments an agent posts on GitHub on the user's behalf.

plugins.name: babysit-pr
plugins.description: Watch a PR through CI and bot reviews in T3 Code, fix or dismiss findings, and keep it current with its base branch.

plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: Keep the per-user Claude Code setup the same on every machine you work from: version, skill repos, plugins, CLAUDE.md and settings.

plugins.name: bro
plugins.description: /bro: restate the last message in plain human language, with no jargon.

plugins.name: cdt
plugins.description: The cdt MCP (chrome-devtools-mcp) in every project: an agent's own Chrome with console, network and performance tools.
